Source formula: mean(SAER over event days 0–3); SAER = |CRSP total return − CRSP value-weighted market return| / SD(|daily excess return| over event days −10 to −6 and 6 to 10) Source definition: For firm i at a regular Form 10-K filing date, the mean standardized absolute excess return (SAER) over event days 0 through 3. Daily absolute excess return is the absolute difference between the firm’s CRSP daily total return and the CRSP daily value-weighted total return index. SAER divides this absolute excess return by its standard deviation over the non-information estimation days −10 to −6 and 6 to 10 around filing day 0. Raw component fields: CRSP.DSF: PERMNO, DATE, RET, PRC, SHROUT, VOL, CUSIP; CRSP.DSI: DATE, vwretd; WRDSSEC.WCIKLINK_GVKEY: cik, gvkey; CRSP.CCMXPF_LINKTABLE: gvkey, lpermno, linkdt, linkenddt, linkprim, linktype, liid Preserve raw missing values and denominators; do not impute missing source components or force an observed classification.

Source formula: AA_it = 1 if (Compustat annual #123 − #308) / #216 > year median; 0 if below; exact ties unspecified. The supporting residual-market-capitalization regression does not identify its estimation period, population, per-year versus pooled fit, market-cap measure or log base.

The IH variable requires institutional positions from managers with at least $100 million AUM; a full 1996–2001 manager universe and AUM filter source are not established by the available SEC structured dataset or local TFN probe.
For 10-Q AA, quarterly cash flow item 108 may be year-to-date; the source does not specify a quarter-only transformation. Median ties are also unspecified.
The pooled regression estimator and standard-error correction are not named; this is an implementation choice rather than evidence that raw fields are unavailable.
